integrity: The proof is self-contained; finite checker confirms limited test instances and is not substituted for proof. Originality is provisional in light of possible differently named historic results. No independent audit or validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Only finite unweighted trees and a single fixed positive integer radius, with centers constrained to tree vertices; no claim for cycles, weighted real trees or variable-radius spheres; does not enumerate all shattered triples of an arbitrary tree.
title: Fixed-radius tree spheres: a three-type obstruction and sharp \(3r+5\) witness size
